2. SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS
======================

Operating system
  AROS for x86_64 PCs with the ABIv11 system (AROS 2026.09 or newer,
  AROS One 1.3 or newer). Tested on AROS 2026.09 running natively in a
  virtual machine (QEMU/KVM with VMware SVGA and VESA graphics, ES1370
  sound) and hosted on Linux.
  32-bit AROS (i386, ABIv0) and the AROS versions for other processors
  are not supported by this archive.

Processor
  Any x86_64 processor that runs AROS. The music synthesis uses about one
  percent of a current PC.

Memory
  About 2 MB free. With about 8 MB free, the game loads all of its data
  into memory at start-up and never touches the disk again.

Graphics
  Any graphics driver that AROS supports. The game asks AROS for the best
  screen mode for 640x400 with 256 colours; when the driver has no such
  mode it takes a larger one (640x480, or the VESA driver's single mode)
  and shows the picture in its middle, with a black border.

Sound
  AHI with a working driver for your sound hardware (HDAudio, AC97,
  SB128/ES1370 and others come with AROS), set up in the AHI
  preferences. The game plays through unit 0 at 44.1 kHz by default.

Hard disk
  About 7 MB. The voices (optional, section 3) need 48 MB more (261 MB
  for the original voice data).
